clarified_messages.content: Hey, I'm just getting out of here. Need anything else before I drive up?
If you can grab some extra granola bars, that'd be awesome. Also, do you have that thing I lent you last time? (the water filter?)
Exactly! Can we swap at the usual spot or do you want to meet here?
Let's do it here—I'm nearby anyway.
Alright, I’m still at the lot. You’ll see my car next to that old Jeep.
Cool, I’ll find you. I should be there in about 20 minutes.
No sign of Chris here. Maybe he’ll show up soon.
We might need to grab the extra one at my place, but that's a detour.
How far is your place from here?
About 10 minutes south, in Andes.
Alright. Let's wait till 1:30, then decide.
Got it, in my glove box. Anything else?
Maybe the portable charger? Mine's dead.
Yeah, I'll bring mine.
By the way, did you check the forecast for the ridge?
It said clear skies, but I didn’t see the hourly for tonight.
Hope it holds up. Would suck to get rained on like last time.
Oh—one last thing. Did you ask Sam if he's still joining?
Yeah, he texted 'Running late, will meet you guys there.'
Here at the lot or up the trail?
Not sure. I’ll call him now and check.
Just talked to Sam. He said he'll park at the south entrance and hike up to meet us at the first lookout.
Got it. We’ll wait for him until 2 at the lookout, then head onward.
Yes, that’s smart. Just hand it over when you arrive.
Will do. Oh, did Chris confirm what trail he’s taking?
Not to me. If you hear from him, let me know.
Alright. If he’s not here by 1:30, I’ll text him.
Works for me. I’ll start packing up that extra tent just in case.
Good plan. Also, should I bring this topo map or you got one?
Mine’s pretty worn out; bring yours.
Packing it now. See you soon.
Safe drive! Text when you’re close to here.
Getting some water at that little shop—want anything?
Just a bottle for me, thanks!
Alright, see you soon at the lot.
Almost there. Parking now.
I see you. Over here by the old Jeep.
Found you! Here’s the filter and first aid kit.
Perfect. Here’s your bottle.
Thanks. Did you hear from Chris?
Just got a ping—he’s at that gas station on Route 28.
Let’s get our boots on and load up the packs.
